newsitem.title: USA: Alabama National, Firstbanc merger approved.
newsitem.headline: Alabama National, Firstbanc merger approved.

text.p: Alabama National Bancorp said on Friday shareholders of Firstbanc Holding Co Inc had approved their company's merger with Alabama National.
The company said in a statement final approval of the merger was voted by Firstbanc shareholders at a special meeting on Thursday.
Firstbanc is the holding company for First Bank of Baldwin County which will become the eighth bank or thrift owned by Alabama National. The deal is expected to close on Sept 30.

First Bank is based in Robertsdale and has branches in Bay Minette and Daphne, Ala. At June 30, 1996, First Bank had total assets of approximately $35 million, loans of $20 million, and deposits of $31 million.
